cookies.title: Cookies & browser storage
cookies.description: How ToolzCraft uses local preferences, sign-in storage and downloaded resources.

sections.heading: Preferences you choose
sections.text: Favourites, preferred currency and logo selection are stored under toolzcraft.preferences.v1 in localStorage on this browser profile. They remain until you reset them in My tools or clear site data. Other people using this profile can see them. They are not synced with your account. No salary figures, uploaded files or calculator inputs are saved in this preferences record.

sections.heading: Authentication and resource caches
sections.text: If sign-in is configured, Firebase manages authentication persistence in browser storage. Signing out ends the active sign-in but does not delete the operator's account records. Browsers may cache application files and OCR language resources. Clear site data in your browser settings to remove local records and caches; doing so can sign you out.

sections.heading: Advertising choices
sections.text: This version does not run advertising code or set advertising cookies. It does not present a pretend consent banner for services that are not running. If advertising is introduced, the operator must publish the actual vendor disclosures and provide the required consent and withdrawal controls before those services run.

disclaimer.title: Tool results & financial disclaimer
disclaimer.description: Limits of calculators, document processing, SQL translation and external data.

sections.heading: Check important results
sections.text: ToolzCraft is a collection of utilities, not professional advice or a certified payroll system. Keep original files and verify output before using it for a payment, employment offer, tax return, legal document or production database. Browser support, rounding and format limitations can affect results.

sections.heading: Money and compensation
sections.text: Inflation projections are assumptions. Historical CPI describes an average basket and does not establish the actual price of a particular product. The milk example links to published US price data; prices you enter yourself must be checked against the same item, unit and date. CTC is a configurable model: coverage, wage rules, income tax, local levies and employer policies must be supplied or confirmed. Country detection is an approximate network location, not proof of tax residence or payroll jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Files, code and AI
sections.text: Compression may not reduce size and can lose detail. PDF reorganization or conversion can invalidate signatures and remove interactive features. OCR can misread text. SQL translation requires testing against the target database; DB2 support is restricted. AI, where enabled, can return incorrect or invented information. ToolzCraft does not guarantee error-free results or availability.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Accessibility approach and how to report a barrier.

sections.heading: Using the site
sections.text: The tool directory is grouped by category and can be searched. On smaller screens use the Tools button to expand it. Links and buttons support keyboard activation, forms have labels, and status messages identify processing errors. You can change the colour theme in the header and zoom using your browser.

sections.heading: Known limits
sections.text: Some existing tools rely on visual previews, canvas output or wide data tables. Generated PDF files are not guaranteed to be tagged for assistive technology. We have not completed an independent accessibility audit and do not claim WCAG conformance. Keyboard, screen-reader and high-zoom testing remain part of our improvement work.

sections.heading: Report a barrier
sections.text: Use the private contact address on the Contact page. Include the page URL, task you attempted, browser and assistive technology if relevant. Do not send sensitive files. We will use the report to investigate; no fixed resolution deadline is promised.

editorial-policy.title: Content, sources & corrections
editorial-policy.description: How ToolzCraft explains tools, attributes sources and handles corrections.

sections.heading: Useful explanations
sections.text: Tool pages describe inputs, an example where available, and practical limits. Some guidance is shared by category. A description is not a claim that every feature or file format has been independently validated. New financial examples should identify whether their numbers are observed data, user inputs or assumptions.

sections.heading: Sources and independence
sections.text: Where external rules or historical prices are used, we link to the source so readers can verify them. Links to Google, government departments and software projects do not imply endorsement or affiliation. ToolzCraft does not claim Google certification, AdSense approval, a guaranteed search ranking or a guaranteed financial outcome.

sections.heading: Corrections and intellectual property
sections.text: Report a reproducible error or a rights concern through the Contact page. Include the affected URL, a non-sensitive example and supporting source. For copyright concerns, identify the work and the material you believe infringes it, and provide a private reply address. Do not include confidential information in public repository issues. Third-party libraries remain subject to their own licences.

data-requests.title: Privacy requests & deletion
data-requests.description: How to request access, correction or deletion and clear local preferences.

sections.heading: Local preferences and files
sections.text: Reset favourites, currency and logo in My tools. Clear this site's browser data to remove cached resources and authentication storage. Files processed locally are not uploaded by the PDF, image, video, archive or CSV tools. Delete downloaded results using your device's file manager. Resetting preferences does not delete downloads or account records.

sections.heading: Account and server records
sections.text: Contact the operator privately to request access, correction or deletion of account or usage records. State the request and the account identifier you normally use; never send your password, an SMS code or a sign-in token. The operator may need to verify control of the account before acting. Applicable law determines response deadlines, available rights and any lawful retention exceptions.

sections.heading: Other services and complaints
sections.text: Third-party authentication, AI or infrastructure providers may hold separate records under their own terms. The operator should explain the applicable services and any limits on deletion. Depending on your location, you may also have a right to complain to the relevant data-protection authority. A public GitHub issue is not a private data-request channel.

compliance.title: Policies & transparency
compliance.description: Find ToolzCraft's privacy, terms, storage, accessibility and corrections information.

sections.heading: How this site operates
sections.text: ToolzCraft provides browser utilities with optional online features. Most file and calculation tools work without sign-in. Policies describe the current build and must be reviewed whenever the operator enables new services. No page is a certification that every legal obligation in every country has been met.

sections.heading: Advertising status
sections.text: Advertising is not enabled in this build. Google reviews the deployed site and publisher account when an AdSense application is submitted. Documentation, metadata and a sitemap cannot guarantee approval.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.text: Use My tools to manage browser-local favourites, currency and logo. Read Cookies & browser storage to learn how to clear stored preferences. For account requests, accessibility barriers or corrections, use the Contact page.
